name: @versatiles/svg-renderer
description: Renders MapLibre styles as SVG, in Node.js or the browser.
author: Michael Kreil <versatiles@michael-kreil.de>

scripts.docs: vrt deps-graph --svg docs/dependency-graph.svg | sed -e 's#](docs/#](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/versatiles-org/versatiles-svg-renderer/main/packages/svg-renderer/docs/#g' -e 's#?raw=true##g' | vrt doc-insert README.md '## Dependency Graph' && prettier --write --log-level warn README.md
